story.title: RAINBOW RIYA
paragraphs_en: There once lived a little girl name Riya who was 12 years old. She was a very special and unique little girl. She had the most beautiful 'greeny-grey' eyes and the sweetest smile. Riya also had the kindest heart. She could never bear to see any person or animal in pain, and would always try to help them out. She loved nature and always made sure she took good care of the environment by growing plants and avoiding littering. BUT DO YOU KNOW WHAT MADE HER SO VERY SPECIAL?

She saw the world in rainbow colours, not the boring colours we see! When she wanted to, with her mind, she could also sprinkle glitter on ANYTHING and make it sparkle! Sadly, Riya did not feel that this was such an amazing gift. In fact, she felt ashamed of her talent and wished that she could see the world as everyone else did. This had not always been the case. When she was younger and out in the garden, delighting in the smell of roses and playing with her animal friends she had really enjoyed her rainbow sight with splotches of glitter. However, as soon as she started going to school, things changed. WHY DO YOU THINK THAT WAS?

She would often get scolded by her teachers for not focusing on her lessons or not reading off the board properly, while her classmates would laugh at her and tease her. When she tried telling them that she couldn't see the writing properly due to the bright pretty colours and the splotches of glitter floating everywhere, or that often she would get distracted by how beautiful her friends' rainbow coloured faces and dresses would look, nobody believed her. SO SHE HAD STOPPED TRYING TO EXPLAIN.

One night, a terrible storm struck her town and brought it to its knees. All the generators and power backups had all got fused and everything was in complete darkness. All the children felt scared and sat huddled in corners, while adults ran around trying to find torches and candles. The next day loomed dark and grey. And the day after, and the day after that! It was almost as if someone had 'put-out' the sun on purpose. Everyone was getting really worried now. The town had turned quiet and eerie, like a ghost town. However, they kept hearing laughter and giggles coming from Riya's house. "WHATEVER IS GOING ON?", THEY ASKED EACH OTHER.

The next evening, her friends and even some of her school teachers went across to her house to see what was going on. When they entered her house, it was like a magical wonderland. The house shone bright with splashes of rainbow colours and blobs of glitter in between. It was the most beautiful sight they had ever seen. Riya was delighted that now it was not just she who could see the beautiful colours. When Riya moved, the colours seemed to move with her. They all rushed over to Riya and hugged her. "COULD YOU PLEASE HELP US GET RID OF THIS DARK?" THEY ASKED HER.

So Riya went from house to house, shop to shop, restaurant to restaurant and school to school, bringing brightness and spreading rainbow colours and glitter wherever she went. People lined up on the roads to cheer her on and clap for her for bringing back colour, light and joy into their lives. FROM THAT DAY ON RIYA NEVER HAD TO HIDE HER SPECIAL GIFT AGAIN. SHE BECAME THE HAPPIEST LITTLE 12 YEAR OLD IN ALL THE LAND!
